title: Uruguayan Empanada Beef Filling
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish, this beef filling is perfect for empanadas. Savor the flavors of Uruguay in every bite.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the yellow onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the butter to the skillet and stir until melted.
Season the beef mixture with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using).
Let the beef mixture cool to room temperature.
Place a spoonful of the beef mixture into the center of each empanada shell.
Fold the empanada in half and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
